purpose: New player-stat prop adapters; never reuse team-winner probabilities as player-stat probabilities

efficiency.reason: The owner's PL-spread-to-moneyline rule is not a player-stat forecast

inputs: Verified regular-season player observations strictly before prediction ET date
rating_targets: Player actual exceeds an integer-stat threshold, not team game winner
xgboost_training_thresholds: Prior-only mean plus [-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1] standard deviations, rounded to half lines
validation: One frozen chronological 80/20 split by whole ET dates; no hyperparameter selection on validation
xgboost_gate: Finite validation Brier <= 0.25; record baseline comparison and coverage, never claim proven betting accuracy
performance_policy: Only immutable published pregame selections enter live model win/loss records; synthetic training thresholds never become historical bet records
probability_policy: Separate Over, Under and Push; no confidence offsets or copied model probabilities
